newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia bourse bans brokerage Dadas from trading.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia bourse bans brokerage Dadas from trading.

text.p: The Ljubljana bourse said on Thursday its honorary court decided to ban Dadas from trading for six months after finding the brokerage rigged prices by trading among its affiliated companies.
The bourse said the brokerage can appeal against the decision within the next 15 days.
"We will appeal because we strongly disagree with the verdict," Dadas spokesman Andrej Rakovic told Reuters.
Following the verdict, shares of listed financial consultancy Dadas, the owner of the brokerage, dropped 4.6 percent to 13,990 tolars in early Thursday morning trade.
Traders said further losses in Dadas' share price was unlikely as the shares had already plunged 94.2 percent since the end of March, when the company first ran into trouble.
Dadas' share price hit a peak of 390,000 tolars on August 26, 1993. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
